summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc., a Toronto-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC incorporating its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO interim certifications dated November 12, 2026. This is a routine Canadian quarterly reporting package (equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q), not a special situation. Balance sheet shows C$93.7M cash, C$230.1M PP&E, deferred acquisition costs, and a C$39.6M share capital increase. No transaction, shareholder, or board action is announced; no deal terms apply.
